Name: Let's Start With Fishing
Author: TheOneHermes
Description:
[b]Let's Start With Fishing[/b]

Welcome to the [b][b]Let's Start With Fishing [/b]Mod[/b]! This mod is designed to enhance your Stardew Valley fishing experience.

[b]Main Purpose:[/b] The primary purpose of this mod is to provide the player with a  fishing rod at the start of the game. Instead of starting with no fishing pole. On the first day the player will receive the bamboo fishing pole.

[b]Features:[/b]

[b]Save Game Compatible:[/b] The mod is compatible with your save games. It checks if the world is ready before upgrading the fishing rod.
[b]Easy to Install:[/b] Simply drop it into your Mods folder and you're good to go!
[b]Future Plans:[/b] I plan to add more features in the future, such as customizable fishing rod types and upgrade timings. Stay tuned for updates!
